sections.title: Design information
sections.sql: select rr.number,rr.name,rr.code,rr.purpose,rr.test_evidence,rr.use_instructions from revision_register rr join changes c on c.revision_id=rr.id where c.id=$1

name: design-handover
title: Design handover draft
for_each: select id,number||'-'||code as name from revision_register

sections.title: Direct components
sections.sql: select p.number,r.code,r.status,b.quantity,b.unit from bom_lines b join revisions r on r.id=b.child_id join parts p on p.id=r.part_id where b.parent_id=$1

sections.title: Unresolved gaps
sections.note: A blank list means these record checks passed. An engineer must assess design safety.
sections.sql: select gap from release_gaps where id=$1
